entities.summary: Is sweden's oldest public art museum, and one of the oldest in europe was opened in 1794  Originating c. 1794 CE. Gustav III's museum of antiquities is a art museum with roots in Europe, arising around 1794. Attributed to Charles XIII of Sweden.
